name: Protein
oneLine: A folded chain of amino acids. The cell’s workers.
howItWorks: The order of amino acids decides how the chain folds. The fold decides the job: cutting, carrying, building or gating. A wrong amino acid can ruin the fold.
deeper: A typical bacterial protein is about 300 amino acids long. Some fold on their own; others need helper proteins.
sizeComparison: a 20,000th the width of a hair
simplification: Proteins are drawn as smooth blobs, tinted by job.
